name: T Default — Mid and Donut Control
objective: Take mid and donut for information, keep everyone alive, then commit to whichever site the CTs have thinned out.
summary: CALL: two mid behind the smoke, one donut, two on B ramp. Default until 1:10, then hit the side that gave up contact.
required_utility: 1 mid smoke, 1 molotov for donut, 2 flashes for the first A main peek.
steps: Two players take mid behind an early smoke and hold the boxes for information — no hero peeks.
One player walks donut quietly and listens for rotations; they are the lurk when the call comes.
Two hold B ramp, trade every contact, and keep the CTs honest on that side.
At 1:10 the IGL calls the site off what mid and B ramp found, and the mid pair joins the hit.
timings: 1:50 — mid smoke, spread mid / donut / B ramp.
1:10 — commit call; everyone regroups on the chosen side.
0:40 — latest plant, then hold the post-plant crossfire.
midround: Mid opens cheap: push the boxes and take the A ramp entrance before the rotation lands.
Two contacts on B ramp: keep them busy there and swing everything through mid to A.
reactions: Double AWP on mid — stop peeking, molotov the angle and play the B ramp lane instead.
The donut player dies for free: assume A is stacked and default to B.
warnings: Nobody commits while the mid pair is trading blind. Map control first, execute second.
backup: If the default has given you nothing by 0:55, run a five-man B ramp hit and play the post-plant from cave.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Mid Priority
objective: Hold mid so either site can be supported, and give up nothing for free in the first thirty seconds.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 mid, 2 B. Mid has priority — the first sign of a mid take and the nearest site sends one across.
required_utility: 1 mid smoke or molotov for the early contest, 1 A ramp molotov, 1 B ramp molotov.
steps: Mid player takes the early duel only with a teammate watching; otherwise they play for information and fall back.
A pair splits between the ramp entrance and site, one always in a position that can trade the other.
B pair holds ramp from a crossfire — one close, one deep — and burns the ramp on any five-man noise.
Every retake regroups first: no one enters the site alone with utility still in the bag.
timings: 1:50 — set the crossfires, no early aggression without a trade partner.
1:20 — mid player reports what is happening and the stack shifts one player if needed.
0:40 — start the retake, together, on utility.
midround: Mid is lost: pull the mid player back to the site he can reach first and play a 3-2 stack.
Both entrances quiet at 1:00 — expect a late five-man; collapse only on confirmed contact.
reactions: Fast B ramp: burn the ramp, delay from the anchor's crossfire and let the rotation arrive before trading.
A split through mid: give the site, keep the players, retake from two directions.
warnings: Do not push mid without a smoke and a trade. A dead mid player is a free site for the T side.
backup: If the mid player keeps dying, drop to a 3-2 with no mid presence and play a pure retake round.

name: T Default — Mid and Water Control
objective: Own mid and the water crossing so both sites stay open, then commit late with everyone alive.
summary: CALL: two mid, one water, two A main. Trade every duel, decide the site at 1:05.
required_utility: 2 mid smokes, 1 molotov for the connector, 2 flashes for the A main entry.
steps: Smoke the CT sightline into mid and take the mid boxes with two players.
One player crosses water for information and to threaten the B rotation.
Two hold A main, take space without peeking the connector alone, and wait for the call.
Commit at 1:05 with the mid pair joining whichever side is thin.
timings: 1:50 — mid smoke, spread mid / water / A main.
midround: Mid is free: take the connector and threaten both sites from the middle of the map.
Water contact wins: swing everything B before the CTs re-set.
reactions: AWP holding mid: re-smoke and cross under it rather than trading rifles for an AWP.
A main gets molotoved early — that is usually a two-player A hold; take mid harder.
warnings: Water is loud. Cross once, with a purpose, and never as a lone lurk with no support.
backup: No control by 0:55: five-man A main with everything you have left and plant for the post-plant crossfire.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Mid Support
objective: Deny mid cheaply, keep both sites supportable, and win rounds on rotations rather than opening duels.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 mid, 2 B. Mid plays for information; the connector is the rotation, keep it clear.
required_utility: 1 mid molotov, 1 smoke for the water crossing, 1 A main molotov.
steps: Mid player holds from a position they can leave alive and calls the first push.
A pair sets a crossfire covering main and connector, one always trading the other.
B pair holds the main entrance and the far angle, with the molotov saved for a rush.
Rotate through connector as a pair, never one at a time into an open site.
timings: 1:50 — crossfires set, mid checks and falls back.
1:15 — the stack shifts one player toward the reported pressure.
midround: Water is taken: assume B and pre-rotate one from A through connector.
Nothing found by 1:00: expect a late hit, hold the angles and stop peeking.
reactions: Five-man A main: delay with the molotov, fall back off site and retake with the rotation.
Mid smoke goes up early — that is a split; hold the site, not the smoke.
warnings: Never contest mid alone once the smokes are out. Information is worth more than the duel.
backup: If mid keeps falling, drop to a 3-2 stack, give mid away and play pure retakes with saved utility.

name: T Default — Mid Control into A
objective: Win the mid floor cheaply and turn it into an A opening, with B main as the fallback the CTs have to respect.
summary: CALL: two through garage to the mid floor, one B main, two A main. On mid control, execute A; otherwise hit B.
required_utility: 1 smoke for the CT connector, 1 molotov for the mid boxes, 2 flashes for the A main exit.
steps: Smoke the connector from inside garage, then take the mid floor with two players.
One player holds B main to keep the B anchor at home — no solo entry.
Two hold A main and stay unseen until the mid call comes.
On mid control, the A main pair enters on flashes while mid takes the site from behind.
timings: 1:50 — connector smoke, spread garage / A main / B main.
midround: Mid is empty: take highway and open A from the back before the rotation.
B main contact wins the duel: everyone swings B, mid holds the rotation.
reactions: AWP in checkers: molotov it and cross the mid floor under the smoke instead of peeking it.
The A main pair gets molotoved: that is an aggressive anchor — punish with the mid entry.
warnings: Do not walk into the mid floor before the connector smoke lands. It is the whole reason the take works.
backup: No mid by 0:55: five-man B main with the molotov on heaven and plant for the vents crossfire.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 Mid Priority
objective: Keep the mid floor contested so neither site can be taken for free, and retake as a group when it goes.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 mid, 2 B. Mid holds the boxes for information and falls back the moment it is smoked.
required_utility: 1 molotov for the mid floor, 1 A main molotov, 1 smoke for the B retake.
steps: Mid player holds the boxes with a teammate ready to trade from A, and leaves alive when the smokes come out.
A pair covers main and the back of site in a crossfire — never both looking at the same angle.
B pair holds main and heaven, burning main on the first rush noise.
Retakes go together, with utility, from two directions.
timings: 1:50 — set up, mid checks the floor and reports.
1:20 — shift one player toward the reported pressure.
midround: Mid falls: pull back to the sites and play a 3-2, giving up the floor rather than a player.
No contact by 1:00: expect a late execute — reset utility and hold.
reactions: Fast B main: delay from heaven, fall off site and retake with the A rotation.
Highway pressure means an A split is coming — hold site, not the entrances.
warnings: Do not hold the mid floor after it is smoked. Trading it for a player loses the round twice over.
backup: If mid is lost every round, stack 3-2 and play a full retake game with saved utility.

name: T Default — Long and Catwalk Pressure
objective: Threaten long and catwalk at the same time so the CTs cannot commit, then take the site that gives first.
summary: CALL: two long, one mid doors, two tunnels. Take space, trade everything, commit at 1:05.
required_utility: 1 smoke for the long corner, 1 smoke for mid doors, 1 molotov for the catwalk peek, 2 flashes.
steps: Smoke the long corner and take long control with two players — no blind wide peeks.
One player takes mid doors for the catwalk threat and the B rotation read.
Two take upper tunnels and hold there for the call.
Commit at 1:05: A through long with the mid player cutting off the rotation, or B out of tunnels.
timings: 1:50 — long corner smoke, spread long / mid / tunnels.
midround: Long is free: take the pit and force the rotation, then decide.
Tunnels contact wins: hit B immediately while the CT is still one down.
reactions: AWP holding long: re-smoke and go B — do not feed it.
Doors molotov on your mid player means an aggressive CT mid; take catwalk behind it.
warnings: Do not take long with one player. Every angle there needs a trade behind it.
backup: No space by 0:55: five-man B tunnels on the last flashes and play the post-plant from the back of site.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Mid Doors Priority
objective: Hold mid so rotations stay fast, delay both sites with utility, and retake together.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 mid, 2 B. Mid plays doors for information, never for a hero duel.
required_utility: 1 molotov for catwalk, 1 molotov for tunnels, 1 smoke for the long corner.
steps: Mid player checks doors early with a trade from A, then plays passive for the catwalk read.
A pair splits long and site — the long player delays with utility instead of duelling.
B pair holds tunnels and the far angle, burning tunnels on the first rush noise.
Rotate through mid only when it is confirmed clear; otherwise take the long way as a pair.
timings: 1:15 — one player shifts toward the reported pressure.
midround: Catwalk taken: pull mid back to A and play the site instead of the corridor.
Quiet at 1:00: expect a late five-man, hold angles and stop peeking.
reactions: Tunnels rush: molotov, delay from the crossfire and retake with the mid rotation.
Long smoke without contact usually means a fake — do not commit both A players to it.
warnings: Losing the mid player early costs you both rotations. Information beats the duel.
backup: If mid keeps dying, drop to 3-2, give up mid and play retakes with all utility saved.

name: T Default — Banana Control and Apartments
objective: Take banana with utility, hold it, and use the threat to open A through apartments and second mid.
summary: CALL: three banana with the molotov, two apartments. Hold banana, decide the side at 1:05.
required_utility: 1 molotov and 1 smoke for banana, 1 smoke for the CT sightline into second mid, 2 flashes for the balcony drop.
steps: Molotov the banana choke, take the top with three players and hold it — do not over-push into CT.
Two take apartments quietly and hold balcony for information.
If banana holds, one stays there and the rest swing A through second mid.
Commit at 1:05 with flashes for whichever entrance you chose.
timings: 1:30 — banana control confirmed or given up.
midround: Banana is free: keep two there as a real B threat and take A with three through second mid.
Apartments meets an aggressive CT — trade it and hit A immediately while they are one down.
reactions: Double molotov on banana means a heavy B hold; give it up and take A.
Balcony gets flashed and pushed: fall back to apartments, trade, and re-take the space with utility.
warnings: Do not push out of banana without the second molotov. Falling back with five alive beats owning banana with three.
backup: No control by 0:55: five-man B out of banana on the last utility and play the post-plant from the back of site.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Banana Priority
objective: Deny banana with utility rather than duels, hold A with a crossfire, and retake as a group.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 apartments, 2 B. Banana gets the molotov every round — the duel is optional, the utility is not.
required_utility: 1 banana molotov (every round), 1 smoke for the banana fallback, 1 molotov for apartments.
steps: B pair molotovs banana on the standard timing and plays the crossfire behind it, never both peeking.
The apartments player checks balcony for information and falls back to A when the utility comes out.
A pair holds pit and the back of site so a fast take still has to trade twice.
Retakes are grouped and on utility — no solo entries into a planted site.
timings: 1:20 — one player shifts toward reported pressure.
midround: Banana given up early: pull both B players back to site and play the retake from CT.
Apartments quiet at 1:00: expect a B commit, pre-rotate one player.
reactions: Five-man banana: burn it, fall back off site, retake with the A rotation and utility.
Second mid smoke means an A split — hold the site, not the corridors.
warnings: Never trade the apartments player for free. Falling back with information wins more rounds than the opening kill.
backup: If banana falls every round, stack 3-2 to B and play A as a pure retake site.

name: T Default — Top Mid Control
objective: Take top mid and connector pressure so both sites open up, then commit late with five alive.
summary: CALL: two top mid behind the smokes, one palace, two apartments. Default until 1:05, then hit the thin side.
required_utility: Window smoke, top mid smoke, 1 molotov for connector, 2 flashes for the entry.
steps: Smoke window and top mid, then take the mid boxes with two players.
One player takes palace quietly for the A threat and the connector read.
Two hold apartments and stay unseen — no early underpass noise.
Commit at 1:05: A with palace and mid, or B out of apartments with the mid pair cutting the rotation.
timings: 1:50 — window and top mid smokes, spread mid / palace / apartments.
midround: Connector opens: take it and split A from two directions immediately.
Apartments contact wins: hit B while the CT is a player down.
reactions: AWP re-peeking top mid through the smoke: molotov the spot and move on rather than trading.
Palace gets molotoved early — expect an aggressive A hold and swing B.
warnings: Do not cross top mid before both smokes land, and never as a lone player with no trade.
backup: Nothing by 0:55: five-man apartments, plant for the market and van crossfire and play the post-plant.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Window Priority
objective: Contest mid early with utility, keep window alive, and make every take cost the T side two trades.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 window, 2 B. Window plays for information and falls back the moment the smokes come out.
required_utility: 1 molotov for top mid, 1 A ramp molotov, 1 smoke for the B retake.
steps: The mid player holds window, checks top mid early and leaves alive once it is smoked.
A pair covers ramp and palace in a crossfire, with the ramp molotov saved for the execute.
B pair holds apartments and the far angle, one always able to trade the other.
Rotate through connector as a pair and retake together on utility.
timings: 1:50 — positions set, window checks top mid.
1:15 — shift one player toward the reported pressure.
midround: Mid is smoked and taken: pull window back to A and play a 3-2.
Nothing found by 1:00: expect a late execute — reset utility and hold your angles.
reactions: Fast apartments: molotov underpass, delay from the crossfire and retake with the A rotation.
Palace and ramp utility at the same time is a full A execute — give the site, keep the players.
warnings: Do not hold window after the smokes land. A dead mid player hands the T side connector for free.
backup: If mid is lost every round, drop to 3-2 with no window presence and play pure retakes.

name: T Default — Outside Control
objective: Take outside with utility to open the B threat, and use lobby pressure so the CTs cannot fully commit.
summary: CALL: three outside behind the smokes, two lobby. Hold outside, decide upper or lower at 1:05.
required_utility: 2 smokes for the outside crossing, 1 molotov for the far corner, 2 flashes for the lobby entry.
steps: Smoke the outside crossing and take the space with three players — cross together, not one at a time.
Two hold lobby for the upper threat and to read the rotation.
Hold what you took: outside control is the round, do not trade it away early.
Commit at 1:05 — lower through secret with the lobby pair holding upper, or a full upper hit off the outside threat.
midround: Outside is free: push secret early and take lower before the rotation arrives.
Lobby wins its duel: hit upper immediately while the CT side is one down.
reactions: Heavy outside utility means a stacked yard — swing back to lobby and hit upper.
The secret door opens on you: fall back, trade, and re-take with the last smokes.
warnings: Do not cross outside without both smokes. One player caught in the open loses the whole plan.
backup: No control by 0:55: five-man lobby on the last flashes and play the post-plant from the back of upper.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 Ramp and Yard
objective: Deny outside cheaply, hold ramp with utility, and keep lower supportable from heaven.
summary: CALL: 2 upper, 1 yard, 2 lower/ramp. Yard plays for information, ramp gets the molotov every round.
required_utility: 1 ramp molotov (every round), 1 smoke for the yard fallback, 1 molotov for the secret entrance.
steps: The yard player takes the early information duel only with a trade, then falls back inside.
Ramp is burned on the standard timing and held from a crossfire, not a solo peek.
Upper pair covers hut and the back of site so a fast take still has to trade twice.
Rotate through heaven as a pair and retake lower together on utility.
timings: 1:50 — ramp molotov, positions set, yard checks.
1:20 — shift one player toward the reported pressure.
midround: Outside is lost: pull the yard player in and play upper and heaven rather than contesting the open.
Nothing by 1:00: expect a late lower hit through secret — pre-rotate one to heaven.
reactions: Five-man ramp: burn it, delay from the crossfire, retake lower with the upper rotation.
Vents noise during an outside take is usually the split — hold the site, not the corridor.
warnings: Never lose the yard player for free. Without them you are blind to every outside timing.
backup: If outside falls every round, give it up by default, stack upper 3-2 and play lower as a retake site.

name: T Default — Ivy and Popdog Control
objective: Take ivy and popdog to threaten A from two directions, while B keeps the CTs from over-committing.
summary: CALL: two ivy, one popdog, two toward B. Hold the space, commit at 1:05 with everyone alive.
required_utility: 1 smoke for the ivy exit, 1 molotov for popdog, 2 flashes for the A entry.
steps: Two take ivy behind the smoke and hold it — the space matters more than the opening kill.
One takes popdog for the connector read and the rotation cut.
Two hold the B side, trade every contact and keep the anchor honest.
Commit at 1:05: A with the ivy pair and popdog, or B with the mid players cutting the rotation.
timings: 1:50 — ivy smoke, spread ivy / popdog / B.
midround: Ivy is free: take the connector and open A from two sides before the rotation lands.
B contact wins: swing everything there while the CT side is one down.
reactions: AWP holding the ivy exit: re-smoke and take popdog instead of feeding it.
Popdog molotoved early means an aggressive connector — punish with the A entry.
warnings: Do not enter a site off one player's space. The default only pays off if you commit together.
backup: Nothing by 0:55: five-man B with the last utility and play the post-plant from behind the trains.

name: CT Default — 2-1-2 with Connector Priority
objective: Hold connector so both sites stay reachable, delay with utility, and retake as a group.
summary: CALL: 2 A, 1 connector, 2 B. Connector plays for information and never duels without a trade.
required_utility: 1 molotov for ivy, 1 molotov for the B entrance, 1 smoke for the retake.
steps: The connector player checks ivy early with a trade behind them, then plays passive.
A pair holds the site from a crossfire between the trains, never both on the same angle.
B pair delays the entrance with the molotov and falls back rather than trading blind.
Retakes are grouped, on utility, and from two directions.
timings: 1:15 — shift one player toward reported pressure.
midround: Ivy and popdog are both taken: pull connector back to A and play a 3-2.
Quiet at 1:00: expect a late five-man — reset utility and hold your angles.
reactions: Fast B: burn the entrance, delay from the crossfire and retake with the A rotation.
Smokes on the connector mean a split is coming — hold the site, not the corridor.
warnings: Losing connector for free gives the T side both sites at once. Information first, duels second.
backup: If connector keeps falling, stack 3-2, give it up by default and play a pure retake round.
